governs: Phase F (Spec 001 / ADR-0002) quality acceptance only
source_of_definitions: specs/001-hybrid-intent-routing/acceptance.md (Gate F safety-first section); architecture.md (framing vetoes); owner decisions F-D4, F-R7
note: Pre-registered BEFORE the corrected re-run (owner decision F-D5: no threshold selection after observing results). These are proposals, not observed values. Observed metrics live in reports/evaluation_report.json (generated by run_evaluation.py). No runtime threshold may change; no tuning is authorized.

near_pair_consistency.scope: adjudicated scored near-pairs (deferred owner-decision groups excluded until disposition)

calibration.interpretation: empirical accuracy within each accepted confidence bucket vs bucket midpoint; never a route-altering gate

zero_support_classes: classes with zero support are reported as 'not_applicable'; they are not treated as perfect scores and do not fail solely due to absent support unless the dataset coverage requirement mandates support
